articles.value: Examining Magic: The Gathering: Foundations, One Year Later
articles.excerpt: Today, we're examining Magic: The Gathering: Foundations, the Magic core set to outdo all other core set expansions that have come before it.
Is Spider-Man 2099 the next Izzet powerhouse? Let's see what this Spider Hero can do with this deck tech from Kara Blinebry.
Is Vivi Ornitier the next big commander in cEDH? Is it going to fill the void left by Nadu? Let's take a look at this deck tech and find out.

articles.value: Archetypes of Imagination - Making a Burn Deck
articles.excerpt: Niv-Mizzet helps your opponents feel the burn of your next Izzet brew!
